notes.title: 30% Off for 14 Days!
notes.content:
Duke is slashing prices by 30% for the next 2 weeks! From now until April 11th, you can explore the mysterious company known as ECCO for a reduced cost. This drop in price is to celebrate the first month that Smile has been on the Steam platform! 

For anyone who may be new, Smile is a first person horror game where the player has to balance enemy mechanics and do consistent resource management in order to survive.

Version 1.1 of Smile was recently released and it includes a significant addition of a computer that contains tips for dealing with each enemy. In order to access these tips, simply locate a computer disk drive during each hour and return it to the computer tower. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36773085/6e033ffe94770c32088b19601bdcd4a5d44a1efa.png[/img]

Various bug fixes and performance optimizations occurred for Version 1.1 so running from those entities should be a little smoother now. 

Good luck in surviving the full night and I am curious to see if you have the patience and self determination to receive that true ending!

notes.title: Version 1.1 Update - Bug Fixes/Performance Increase
notes.content:
Version 1.1 of Smile brings with it a couple of changes to the game. Some more visible than others. 

[b]Visible Changes[/b]
-A computer terminal is now located in the starting room that contains tips for each enemy. In order to access the information, simply find the disk drive during each hour and return it to the computer tower. These tips include information on how to survive and some good techniques.
-The bloody hand prints that signify Olly's potential spawn locations now have a bright glow. This allows players to locate them easier and prepare a suitable route for survival.
-The fog in the Duke's Darkroom has been removed in order to optimize performance in the level as a whole.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
-Fixed a bug where sometimes Chloe did not spawn after 11:00 p.m. 
-Fixed a bug  with the computer in Dr. Blazier's Office.
-Various Smaller Bugs.

[b]Performance Optimizations[/b]
-Switched Anti-Aliasing methods to one that is more acceptable for mid powered computers.
-Deleted/Changed certain Dynamic lights to Stationary/Static lights.
-Removal of certain particle effects.
-Increased usage of LODs in all maps.

I want to personally thank everyone who has tried "Smile" and hope that you have enjoyed yourself! I appreciate all the feedback, whether it is positive or negative, and look forward to all opinions regarding this small update.

Take care and always remember to "[b]Keep on Smiling![/b]"

notes.title: Smile is Out!
notes.content:
The day is actually here! Smile is finally available on Steam! The release of this game was a long time in the making but i am so grateful for the opportunity to be able to post a full game on the Steam platform.

For those of you who are unfamiliar with Smile, it is a First-Person horror survival game that focuses on surviving a long night through resource management and mechanic awareness. It is semi-difficult and personally recommended for ages 12+.

I appreciate the support that I have received on the project so far from friends, family members, and my fellow gamers. I am excited to see what the community thinks as a whole about the story that envelops Theodore. 

Being this is my first game created and released on any platform, i expect for there to be a couple bugs here and there. If you do encounter any issues please feel free to contact me either by email or on my twitter through the contacts listed on the Steam store page.

Any and all suggestion are more than welcome as well and I look forward to seeing videos and screenshots of your game play moments. 
[previewyoutube=_UW6R2NXl7Y;rightthumb][/previewyoutube]
Always remember that you are not alone. If you are personally struggling with mental health issues, please seek help from loved ones and/or trained professionals.

"It's just a bad day, not a bad life" and ALWAYS remember to KEEP ON SMILING!

notes.title: Smile Pre-Release 1.0
notes.content:
After quite a while of development, Smile is finally being released tomorrow! Smile will be available tomorrow around 8:00 a.m. PST or 11:00 a.m. EST. 

This will be the first game that Ecco Studios (myself) has released on Steam so please feel free to let me know if you encounter any errors or if you have any suggestions. 

You can contact me at the email in the contact section or feel free to leave a comment on the Steam page to let me know of any issues if they do arise. 

Aside from that, I am excited to see how the community reacts to a game that deals with a decent amount of mental health topics and the road they can lead someone down. 

[b]Good luck surviving and always remember to keep on Smiling![/b]
